_comment: Components ApiGenerator does not describe, resolved by rule rather than by lookup.
Scoped by component rather than by page, because a page may mix them: a topic can name the Excel
library and a chart in the same sentence, and the chart half should still be checked against the
maps. A term only falls back to the rule when the page declares one of these types in
mentionedTypes and the maps do not answer.
This is NOT for components that merely lack one platform's map. DataChart has maps for every
platform except WPF; a term on it resolves from those, and WPF alone falls back to the canonical
name -- which the resolver already does for any platform with no entry. Listing DataChart here
would throw away the checking the other five platforms make possible.
Add a component here only when no generator describes it anywhere.
